short_description: TAZ identifier
long_description: Internal model TAZ number for the origin zone being reported. Dummy and external zones are excluded and the script prints rows only for zones with positive developable acres.

short_description: County TAZ identifier
long_description: County or local TAZ identifier from the TAZ input DBF. This is carried with the model TAZID for reporting and joins.

short_description: Developable acres
long_description: Developable acreage for the TAZ from the TAZ input. The script filters the output to zones with positive DEVACRES in Urbanization.dbf.

short_description: Households
long_description: Total households in the TAZ from SE_File.dbf TOTHH. This is used to convert access-to-jobs scores into realized access for residents.

short_description: Jobs
long_description: Total employment in the TAZ from SE_File.dbf TOTEMP. This is used to convert access-to-households scores into realized access for jobs or workplaces.

short_description: Potential access to jobs by auto
long_description: Time-decay weighted jobs reachable from the TAZ by congested peak auto. The script sums destination jobs after applying the auto ATO weight based on average AM forward and PM reverse general purpose travel time.

short_description: Potential access to jobs by transit
long_description: Time-decay weighted jobs reachable from the TAZ by peak transit. The value is the higher of walk-access transit and drive-access transit access to jobs.

short_description: Potential access to jobs by bike
long_description: Time-decay weighted jobs reachable from the TAZ by bicycle. Bike travel time is based on straight-line distance between TAZ centroids and the model bike speed.

short_description: Potential access to jobs by walk
long_description: Time-decay weighted jobs reachable from the TAZ by walking. Walk travel time is based on straight-line distance between TAZ centroids and the model walk speed.

short_description: Realized access to jobs by auto
long_description: Job_byAuto multiplied by households in the origin TAZ. Realized means the potential access score is weighted by the number of households that benefit from it so it represents aggregate resident access rather than access for one representative household.

short_description: Realized access to jobs by transit
long_description: Job_byTran multiplied by households in the origin TAZ. Realized means the potential access score is weighted by the number of households that benefit from it so it represents aggregate resident access rather than access for one representative household.

short_description: Realized access to jobs by bike
long_description: Job_byBike multiplied by households in the origin TAZ. Realized means the potential access score is weighted by the number of households that benefit from it so it represents aggregate resident access rather than access for one representative household.

short_description: Realized access to jobs by walk
long_description: Job_byWalk multiplied by households in the origin TAZ. Realized means the potential access score is weighted by the number of households that benefit from it so it represents aggregate resident access rather than access for one representative household.

short_description: Congestion loss in job access
long_description: Computed as Job_byAuto minus tmp_Job_byAuto_FF. It is the signed difference between congested peak auto access and free-flow auto access to jobs; negative values indicate access reduced by congestion.

short_description: Network loss in job access
long_description: Computed as tmp_Job_byAuto_FF minus tmp_Job_byAuto_SL. It is the signed difference between free-flow network access and straight-line reference access to jobs; negative values indicate access reduced by network circuity.

short_description: Total auto loss in job access
long_description: Computed as Loss_Job_Cong plus Loss_Job_Net which is equivalent to Job_byAuto minus tmp_Job_byAuto_SL. It captures the total signed difference between congested auto access and the straight-line reference for jobs.

short_description: Realized congestion loss in job access
long_description: Computed as act_Job_byAuto minus act_Job_byAuto_FF in the script logic. This is the congestion-related job access difference weighted by households in the origin TAZ.

short_description: Realized network loss in job access
long_description: Computed as act_Job_byAuto_FF minus act_Job_byAuto_SL in the script logic. This is the network-circuity job access difference weighted by households in the origin TAZ.

short_description: Realized total auto loss in job access
long_description: Computed as act_Loss_Job_Cong plus act_Loss_Job_Net. This is the total auto job-access difference from congested network travel to the straight-line reference weighted by households in the origin TAZ.

short_description: Potential access to households by auto
long_description: Time-decay weighted households reachable from the TAZ by congested peak auto. The script sums destination households after applying the auto ATO weight based on average AM forward and PM reverse general purpose travel time.

short_description: Potential access to households by transit

short_description: Drive-access transit job access

short_description: Free-flow auto job access

short_description: Straight-line auto job access
long_description: Intermediate potential access to jobs using straight-line travel time. Straight-line time is based on centroid distance and average free-flow auto speed for the origin-destination pair.

short_description: Free-flow auto household access

short_description: Straight-line auto household access
